sources.searcher_note: Pattern: OIG audit (A-06-20-04003) of one academic medical center's Medicare OUTPATIENT outlier payments; found 81 of 117 improperly billed. Different hospital, not joint-specific.

sources.quote: Specifically, outlier payments to 158 hospitals averaged 12.8 percent of their Medicare IPPS reimbursements, compared to an average of only 2.2 percent for all other hospitals.

notes: No source found naming Hershey Medical Center, Lancaster Medical Center or Penn State Health with Medicare outlier payments of any kind, outpatient or inpatient.
